title: Ai Development Orchestrator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai Development Orchestrator em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Location:Remote Type:Full-Time Reports to:CEO Stack:TypeScript, Python, React (Next.Js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users Start:ImmediateThe Company Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale.The Role You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems;
the agents think in code. Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem;
the strongest output isselected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable.What You Do Review every AI-generated commit. Not\ "does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\ " Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear. Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage. Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent. Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix. Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites.Must-Haves Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer;
the AI is the author. Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant. TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems. React in production. Next.Js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns. Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it. Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down. Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations. Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role.Strong Signals Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.Md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison. Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code). Database-level access control in production. Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling. OWASP Top 10 fluency. Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy.Red Flags AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you. Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance. Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify. Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review. Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack. Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership. No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications.Who This Person Is 3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant. You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving.How We Evaluate No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing. Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom? Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything. Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output? AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty.What We Offer A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access. The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory. Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately. A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15M/year, organic-only. A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI;
quality comes from you.To Apply or Refer Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

title: Ai Development Orchestrator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai Development Orchestrator em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Location:Remote Type:Full-Time Reports to:CEO Stack:TypeScript, Python, React (Next.Js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users Start:ImmediateThe Company Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale.The Role You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems;
the agents think in code. Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem;
the strongest output isselected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable.What You Do Review every AI-generated commit. Not\ "does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\ " Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear. Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage. Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent. Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix. Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites.Must-Haves Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer;
the AI is the author. Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant. TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems. React in production. Next.Js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns. Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it. Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down. Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations. Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role.Strong Signals Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.Md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison. Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code). Database-level access control in production. Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling. OWASP Top 10 fluency. Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy.Red Flags AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you. Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance. Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify. Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review. Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack. Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership. No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications.Who This Person Is 3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant. You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving.How We Evaluate No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing. Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom? Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything. Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output? AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty.What We Offer A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access. The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory. Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately. A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15M/year, organic-only. A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI;
quality comes from you.To Apply or Refer Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

Ponto. Não é executar briefings dos outros, é construir e rodar a estratégia com autonomia real. Na prática, isso significa: Estratégia e produção de conteúdo orgânico — definir pauta, produzir e distribuir conteúdo para blog, newsletter e redes sociais (LinkedIn, Instagram e o que mais fizer sentido). Cada peça precisa ter uma tese clara, um objetivo definido e uma métrica de sucesso. Conteúdo SEO-driven que converte intenção em tráfego — produzir conteúdo estratégico para blog e páginas, focado em transformar a intenção de busca em tráfego qualificado. Pesquisa de palavras-chave e otimização on-page — desenvolver pautas com base em keyword research, estruturar heading tags com hierarquia clara, otimizar meta-tags, title, description e a estrutura de URL. IA como parte do processo — usar ferramentas de IA para escalar pesquisa, primeiras versões, variações e distribuição. Você decide onde a IA entra e sai, mantendo a qualidade editorial no padrão da marca. Régua de comunicação com clientes — desenhar e operar a comunicação recorrente com a base: e-mail marketing, avisos de obrigações fiscais, atualizações de produto, comunicados importantes. Cadência, segmentação e copy são suas responsabilidades. Apoio direto às vendas e ao marketing — produzir LPs, VSLs e fluxos de ativação junto com Growth. Gestão dos próprios projetos — você organiza prazo, escopo e prioridade no Notion/ClickUp, comunica status sem precisar ser cobrada(o) e entrega com contexto. Guardiã(o) do tom de voz e do posicionamento — garantir que tudo o que sai da Adaflow soe como Adaflow, em qualquer canal. Você define guidelines, revisa o que outras áreas publicam quando faz sentido e protege a consistência da marca. Colaboração real com Branding e Growth — o modelo de gestão compartilhada significa que você participa das decisões estratégicas, traz dados e perspectiva editorial. O problema do time é também seu problema.O QUE A GENTE PROCURA Experiência sólida em conteúdo digital, de ponta a ponta: blog, newsletter e mídias. Curiosidade ativa com IA aplicada à criação de conteúdo: você testa novas ferramentas por conta própria, tem opinião sobre quais usar e pra quê, e está sempre experimentando o que acabou de sair. Repertório de ferramentas é parte do jogo. O stack que essa cadeira costuma rodar passa por: IA e automação de conteúdo (Automarticles, Greatapps, Lovable, Typebot), gestão de projetos (Notion, ClickUp), design (Figma, Canva), SEO (Ahrefs, SEMrush, Surfer), newsletter e e-mail (Substack, Beehiiv, Mailchimp, RD Station), social (Metricool, Buffer) e análise (GA4, Hotjar). Não precisa ter rodado todas, precisa ter repertório e saber escolher a ferramenta certa pro problema certo. Escrita excelente, com repertório para transitar entre formatos e tons sem perder a voz da marca. Capacidade de tocar projeto sozinho(a). Visão analítica: você precisa considerar CAC, engajamento, tráfego orgânico e conversão como parte do seu trabalho. Comunicação direta, pública e clara.DIFERENCIAIS Automação de marketing e CRM. Vivência em startup ou scale-up de ritmo acelerado, você sabe o que é prazo apertado e prioridade que muda.NEM TODO MUNDO FOI FEITO PARA ESSE RITMO Se você quer um lugar onde alguém te diz exatamente o que escrever, precisa de reuniões intermináveis para tomar decisões ou prefere distribuir responsabilidade do que ser dono do resultado, existem boas empresas pra isso. Essa não é uma delas.Mas se você quer construir a comunicação de uma empresa de tecnologia que está reinventando a contabilidade do Brasil, com automação de ponta, evoluir com gente que coloca a régua pra cima e ter ownership real do que produz, então queremos conhecer você!Inscreva-se pelo formulário:

Ponto. Não é executar briefings dos outros, é construir e rodar a estratégia com autonomia real. Na prática, isso significa: Estratégia e produção de conteúdo orgânico — definir pauta, produzir e distribuir conteúdo para blog, newsletter e redes sociais (LinkedIn, Instagram e o que mais fizer sentido). Você decide onde a IA entra e sai, mantendo a qualidade editorial no padrão da marca. Régua de comunicação com clientes — desenhar e operar a comunicação recorrente com a base: e-mail marketing, avisos de obrigações fiscais, atualizações de produto, comunicados importantes. Cadência, segmentação e copy são suas responsabilidades. Apoio direto às vendas e ao marketing — produzir LPs, VSLs e fluxos de ativação junto com Growth. Gestão dos próprios projetos — você organiza prazo, escopo e prioridade no Notion/ClickUp, comunica status sem precisar ser cobrada(o) e entrega com contexto. Guardiã(o) do tom de voz e do posicionamento — garantir que tudo o que sai da Adaflow soe como Adaflow, em qualquer canal. Você define guidelines, revisa o que outras áreas publicam quando faz sentido e protege a consistência da marca. Colaboração real com Branding e Growth — o modelo de gestão compartilhada significa que você participa das decisões estratégicas, traz dados e perspectiva editorial. O problema do time é também seu problema.O QUE A GENTE PROCURA Experiência sólida em conteúdo digital, de ponta a ponta: blog, newsletter e mídias. Curiosidade ativa com IA aplicada à criação de conteúdo: você testa novas ferramentas por conta própria, tem opinião sobre quais usar e pra quê, e está sempre experimentando o que acabou de sair. Repertório de ferramentas é parte do jogo. O stack que essa cadeira costuma rodar passa por: IA e automação de conteúdo (Automarticles, Greatapps, Lovable, Typebot), gestão de projetos (Notion, ClickUp), design (Figma, Canva), SEO (Ahrefs, SEMrush, Surfer), newsletter e e-mail (Substack, Beehiiv, Mailchimp, RD Station), social (Metricool, Buffer) e análise (GA4, Hotjar). Não precisa ter rodado todas, precisa ter repertório e saber escolher a ferramenta certa pro problema certo. Escrita excelente, com repertório para transitar entre formatos e tons sem perder a voz da marca. Capacidade de tocar projeto sozinho(a). Visão analítica: você precisa considerar CAC, engajamento, tráfego orgânico e conversão como parte do seu trabalho. Comunicação direta, pública e clara.DIFERENCIAIS Automação de marketing e CRM. Vivência em startup ou scale-up de ritmo acelerado, você sabe o que é prazo apertado e prioridade que muda.NEM TODO MUNDO FOI FEITO PARA ESSE RITMO Se você quer um lugar onde alguém te diz exatamente o que escrever, precisa de reuniões intermináveis para tomar decisões ou prefere distribuir responsabilidade do que ser dono do resultado, existem boas empresas pra isso. title: Subject Matter Expert - Chartered & Certified Accountants (Remote)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Subject Matter Expert - Chartered & Certified Accountants (Remote) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Start Date: Ongoing

Screener Criteria: Active professional certification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, etc.)

Eligible Locations:

Language Requirement: Fluent English

Type of contract: Freelance / On-Call Advisory

Hourly Rate: $60.00

Minimum Hours: No minimum

Maximum Hours: Ad hoc / Subject to project availability

About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.

The Opportunity

We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role;
instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.

Please note: This is a\ "bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.

What you'll be doing

When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:

  • Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
  • Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
  • Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional\ "human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2B research is accurate and enterprise-ready.

What you'll bring

  • Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.G., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
  • Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
  • Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
  • Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing.

Why join this project?

This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour, you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.

Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant

Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again;
simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for opportunities.

Links to more information on Prolific

Website

Youtube

Privacy Statement

By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organization planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific's use of your personal information.

description:

ESPECIALISTA DE CONTEÚDO 100% remoto Remuneração competitiva, alinhada à experiência e ao nível de contribuição Autonomia real para construir, testar e escalar Cultura direta, colaborativa e orientada à responsabilidade, execução e crescimentoSOBRE A ADAFLOW A Adaflow nasceu para simplificar a vida de quem presta serviços no Brasil ou no exterior.Ajudamos profissionais e empresas a abrir CNPJ, emitir notas fiscais e cuidar da rotina contábil, sem perder horas com a prefeitura, cartórios, sistemas confusos e burocracias que tiram energia de quem deveria estar focado em crescer.Combinamos tecnologia, automação e atendimento humano para transformar a contabilidade em uma experiência simples, segura e eficiente.Conheça mais em:  agora a gente precisa de alguém que faça com que o conteúdo transmita essa mesma mensagem.O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER Você vai ser dono(a) do conteúdo da Adaflow. Ponto. Não é executar briefings dos outros, é construir e rodar a estratégia com autonomia real. Na prática, isso significa: Estratégia e produção de conteúdo orgânico — definir pauta, produzir e distribuir conteúdo para blog, newsletter e redes sociais (LinkedIn, Instagram e o que mais fizer sentido). Cada peça precisa ter uma tese clara, um objetivo definido e uma métrica de sucesso. Conteúdo SEO-driven que converte intenção em tráfego — produzir conteúdo estratégico para blog e páginas, focado em transformar a intenção de busca em tráfego qualificado. Pesquisa de palavras-chave e otimização on-page — desenvolver pautas com base em keyword research, estruturar heading tags com hierarquia clara, otimizar meta-tags, title, description e a estrutura de URL. IA como parte do processo — usar ferramentas de IA para escalar pesquisa, primeiras versões, variações e distribuição. Você decide onde a IA entra e sai, mantendo a qualidade editorial no padrão da marca. Régua de comunicação com clientes — desenhar e operar a comunicação recorrente com a base: e-mail marketing, avisos de obrigações fiscais, atualizações de produto, comunicados importantes. Cadência, segmentação e copy são suas responsabilidades. Apoio direto às vendas e ao marketing — produzir LPs, VSLs e fluxos de ativação junto com Growth. Gestão dos próprios projetos — você organiza prazo, escopo e prioridade no Notion/ClickUp, comunica status sem precisar ser cobrada(o) e entrega com contexto. Guardiã(o) do tom de voz e do posicionamento — garantir que tudo o que sai da Adaflow soe como Adaflow, em qualquer canal. Você define guidelines, revisa o que outras áreas publicam quando faz sentido e protege a consistência da marca. Colaboração real com Branding e Growth — o modelo de gestão compartilhada significa que você participa das decisões estratégicas, traz dados e perspectiva editorial. O problema do time é também seu problema.O QUE A GENTE PROCURA Experiência sólida em conteúdo digital, de ponta a ponta: blog, newsletter e mídias. Curiosidade ativa com IA aplicada à criação de conteúdo: você testa novas ferramentas por conta própria, tem opinião sobre quais usar e pra quê, e está sempre experimentando o que acabou de sair. Repertório de ferramentas é parte do jogo. O stack que essa cadeira costuma rodar passa por: IA e automação de conteúdo (Automarticles, Greatapps, Lovable, Typebot), gestão de projetos (Notion, ClickUp), design (Figma, Canva), SEO (Ahrefs, SEMrush, Surfer), newsletter e e-mail (Substack, Beehiiv, Mailchimp, RD Station), social (Metricool, Buffer) e análise (GA4, Hotjar). Não precisa ter rodado todas, precisa ter repertório e saber escolher a ferramenta certa pro problema certo. Escrita excelente, com repertório para transitar entre formatos e tons sem perder a voz da marca. Capacidade de tocar projeto sozinho(a). Visão analítica: você precisa considerar CAC, engajamento, tráfego orgânico e conversão como parte do seu trabalho. Comunicação direta, pública e clara.DIFERENCIAIS Automação de marketing e CRM. Vivência em startup ou scale-up de ritmo acelerado, você sabe o que é prazo apertado e prioridade que muda.NEM TODO MUNDO FOI FEITO PARA ESSE RITMO Se você quer um lugar onde alguém te diz exatamente o que escrever, precisa de reuniões intermináveis para tomar decisões ou prefere distribuir responsabilidade do que ser dono do resultado, existem boas empresas pra isso. Essa não é uma delas.Mas se você quer construir a comunicação de uma empresa de tecnologia que está reinventando a contabilidade do Brasil, com automação de ponta, evoluir com gente que coloca a régua pra cima e ter ownership real do que produz, então queremos conhecer você!Inscreva-se pelo formulário:

title: Ai Development Orchestrator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai Development Orchestrator em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Location:Remote Type:Full-Time Reports to:CEO Stack:TypeScript, Python, React (Next.Js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users Start:ImmediateThe Company Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale.The Role You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems;
the agents think in code. Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem;
the strongest output isselected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable.What You Do Review every AI-generated commit. Not\ "does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\ " Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear. Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage. Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent. Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix. Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites.Must-Haves Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer;
the AI is the author. Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant. TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems. React in production. Next.Js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns. Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it. Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down. Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations. Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role.Strong Signals Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.Md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison. Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code). Database-level access control in production. Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling. OWASP Top 10 fluency. Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy.Red Flags AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you. Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance. Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify. Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review. Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack. Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership. No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications.Who This Person Is 3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant. You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving.How We Evaluate No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing. Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom? Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything. Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output? AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty.What We Offer A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access. The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory. Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately. A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15M/year, organic-only. A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI;
quality comes from you.To Apply or Refer Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Development Representative em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Business Development Representative (BDR)About Us XDRhub is a specialized sales and business development outsourcing company. We are professional cold-callers dedicated to helping small and mid-sized businesses grow through tailored outbound strategies. Our mission is simple: empower our clients to thrive in today's competitive marketplace by building their pipelines with high-quality opportunities.About the Role As aBusiness Development Representative (BDR), you will represent one of our clients and act as the first point of contact for prospective buyers. Your primary responsibility is to proactively identify, engage, and qualify decision-makers (Directors, VPs, and C-level executives). This role is highly outbound-driven: you will spend your time cold calling, cold emailing, prospecting via LinkedIn, and using modern sales tools to generate meetings. You'll run early-stage discovery conversations and hand off qualified opportunities to the sales team. You'll be working in a fast-paced environment where communication, persistence, and organization are key.About You We are looking for a driven, articulate communicator who thrives in outbound sales. English Proficiency– Excellent oral and written English (C1 level or higher). Native-like fluency is required, as you will be speaking directly with US-based executives. Sales Mindset– Fearless hunter mentality with a proven ability to prospect, cold call, and build pipeline. Experience with Sales Solutions(Preferred)– Prior experience engaging HR and Finance executives is a strong plus. Curious & Coachable– Eager to learn and grow;
open to feedback, with the ambition to become a top 5% sales professional through our mentoring and training. Self-Starter– Comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with team members. Tech-Savvy– Familiar with tools like Salesforce, HubSpot, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar sales enablement platforms. Comfortable in afast-paced, evolving environment .Key Responsibilities Lead Generation Research and identify prospective buyers within target accounts. Cold call and email Director and above level executives to secure meetings and demos. Team Coordination Work closely with Account Executives to confirm appointments, share call notes, and ensure smooth handoffs. Communicate relevant insights from discovery calls to support the sales team's success. Data Management Maintain accurate records of outreach, leads, conversations, and pipeline progress in both our CRM and client CRMs. Track activity, outcomes, and ensure reporting is up to date. Metrics & KPIs Number of dials per day (150+ average) and meeting conversion rate. Number of meaningful conversations and meetings booked. Email outreach volume and reply rate. Meeting attendance rate. Schedule Full-time, 40 hours/week. Working hours: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM ET. Open to applicants based in LATAM. What We Offer Competitive base salary + commission (60/40 split). SPIFFs and performance incentives. Training, mentoring, and growth opportunities to become a top-performing sales professional.P.S. If you cold call me at -eight-eight on WhatsApp or reach out on LinkedIn, you'll jump to the front of the line.

title: Devops Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Devops Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Sobre nós: A UDS é especialista em desenvolver softwares web e aplicativos personalizados com squads ágeis. Atende marcas como Calvin Klein, DHL, C&A, Madero, SKY, Correios, Yamaha e outras. Foi reconhecida entre as três melhores desenvolvedoras de aplicativos da América Latina e detém certificação PCI-DSS. É a primeira de seu setor na Global Data Alliance junto a companhias como Panasonic, Visa, Pfizer e American Express.Descrição: - Será responsável por garantir a confiabilidade, escalabilidade e resiliência de nossas plataformas e produtos digitais, atuando de ponta a ponta em arquitetura, automação e operações. Suas principais atribuições incluem: - Disponibilidade e Performance: Garantir a disponibilidade, desempenho e escalabilidade dos sistemas e serviços em ambientes de nuvem, aplicando práticas de Site Reliability Engineering. - Observabilidade e Confiabilidade: Projetar e manter SLIs, SLOs e SLAs, criando mecanismos de monitoramento, logging e alertas proativos, prevenindo incidentes antes que afetem os usuários finais. - Automação e Entrega Contínua: Desenvolver e manter pipelines de CI/CD para automatizar deploys, testes e integrações contínuas, reduzindo riscos e aumentando a eficiência. - Gestão de Incidentes: Implementar processos de incident response e post-mortem para identificar, mitigar e aprender com falhas, garantindo melhoria contínua. - Segurança e Compliance: Implementar e manter práticas de segurança de alto nível para proteger dados e cumprir normas de privacidade e compliance (ex.: PCI-DSS, LGPD/GDPR). - Infraestrutura como Código: Utilizar ferramentas de automação e IaC (Infrastructure as Code) para provisionamento, configuração e manutenção de ambientes em AWS ou outras nuvens públicas. - Suporte e Orientação Técnica: Apoiar squads de desenvolvimento, fornecendo orientação sobre práticas de DevOps, infraestrutura e arquitetura, além de atuar como ponto técnico focal. - Otimização de Custos: Identificar oportunidades de redução de custos e otimização de recursos na infraestrutura e serviços em nuvem.Requisitos: - Conhecimentos em Inteligência Artificial aplicada a operações (AIOps), incluindo uso de modelos para detecção de anomalias, previsão de incidentes e automação inteligente de respostas. Experiência com integração de serviços de IA (ex.: APIs de modelos de linguagem), uso de pipelines de dados para treinamento/consumo de modelos e entendimento de conceitos como Machine Learning, NLP e observabilidade orientada por IA. - Experiência sólida em administração de sistemas Linux e Windows, incluindo configuração, monitoramento e troubleshooting. - Proficiência em automação e IaC, utilizando ferramentas como Terraform, Ansible ou similares. - Experiência prática em cloud computing, preferencialmente AWS (EC2, VPC, RDS, S3, CloudFront, Load Balancer). - Vivência com contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes). - Conhecimento em serviços web e servidores (Nginx, Apache, IIS, etc.). - Experiência em monitoramento e observabilidade, usando ferramentas como Grafana, Prometheus, Zabbix, Graylog, Datadog ou similares. - Forte compreensão de práticas DevOps e SRE (SLI/SLO, capacidade de resposta a incidentes, gestão de disponibilidade). - Experiência com pipelines de CI/CD (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins ou similares). - Habilidades de comunicação para colaborar com times multidisciplinares e interagir com clientes. - Certificações em AWS, DevOps, Kubernetes ou áreas correlatas são altamente desejáveis.Desejáveis: - Experiência prévia em ambientes de alta disponibilidade (produtos de larga escala). - Atuação anterior em equipes de SRE ou como engenheiro responsável por confiabilidade de sistemas críticos. - Conhecimentos de FinOps para otimização de custos em cloud.Vantagens: - Programa de mentoria que te acompanha durante sua fase de adaptação;
- Vaga 100% remota;
- Acesso a cursos e certificações;
- Aulas de inglês custeada pela empresa.

title: Customer Retention Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Retention Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us: Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market.We're building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us?About you: This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Retention Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you'll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them. As a result, retained revenue will follow with subscription renewals, of which you will be responsible for attaining a monthly quota.What You'll Own: Responsible for reducing churn by retaining customers and revenue. You'll own a monthly customer retention quota as your main KPI. Apply approved retention strategies (in-app credits, billing credits, plan downgrades, and success enablement) within defined guidelines. Intercept downgrade requests and reposition value through usage planning, campaign scheduling, and ROI alignment before the plan change is approved. Identify and recover failed onboarding cases by re-driving activation and time-to-first-value. Perform proactive outreach to low-usage and disengaged accounts using structured "silent churn" playbooks to re-engage customers before cancellation intent surfaces. Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.What We're Looking For: 5+ years in a customer retention or account management role. 3+ years within a SaaS company. Conduct 50+ weekly retention calls via phone or Google Meet. Proven ability to analyze customer behavior, identify churn risks, and take targeted action to retain accounts. Strong objection handling, negotiation, and behavioral communication skills with the ability to influence customer decisions under pressure. Ability to diagnose and act on different churn drivers (budget, usage, performance, lifecycle, compliance) with tailored retention strategies. Able to work efficiently in a high-activity environment without sacrificing quality. Comfortable holding long-format video calls for reviewing customer accounts and demonstrating product value. Coachable, performance-driven, accountable, and a strong team player. Proficient or native level English (full business fluency). Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 am and 7 pm EST, Monday to Friday. Bonus Points: Experience working at a CPaaS or Martech SaaS company. Experience working with real estate professionals.️ Why Smarter Contact? USD base compensation 15 days PTO + 5 sick days + 10 floating holidays (6 weeks off) High autonomy, fast execution, real impact Professional development benefit Wellness benefit Employment anniversary and birthday gift Quarterly health allowance Remote-first team with a strong performance culture This opportunity is offered as a full-time independent contractor rolePlease Don't Apply If: You prefer a low-pressure, low-output environment You're not fluent in English or are uncomfortable communicating directly with cross-functional teams You don't meet the minimum customer success experience No experience working for a SaaS companyReady to grow with us? We're looking for a proven Customer Retention Specialist ready to build the next chapter of their career — and stay for the long haul. If that's you, we'd love to hear from you.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Video Editor em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description ONDA Creative Studio is a format development and production studio based in London, producing content for creators and brands across YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and beyond. We're hiring a senior video editor to join the team on a part-time retainer basis.The Role You'll be the lead editor across multiple creator and brand projects. The primary focus is a recurring live dating show format filmed in front of a live audience — approximately 90 minutes, filmed with 4 cameras, edited into a 45-60 minute hero video plus 4-5 short-form cutdowns. Beyond this, you'll edit long-form YouTube content, short-form brand and creator videos, fitness content, social-first reels, and campaign pieces for clients across a range of industries and platforms.What You'll Do Edit long-form content (45-60 min) from unscripted, multi-camera live footage. Build narrative, manage pacing, create hooks Cut short-form content for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and LinkedIn — platform-native edits with hooks, captions, and pacing Sync and assemble multicam footage (4 camera angles) from live events Sound design and colour grade to a broadcast-ready standard Edit across a variety of content types: creator, brand partnership, fitness, talking head, social-first, and event content Work within DaVinci Resolve shared project environments where possible, so timelines are accessible to the wider team Use AI tools (specifically Higgsfield) for short-form content workflows where appropriateWhat We're Looking For Strong long-form editing skills (15+ min). You understand pacing, retention, hooks, and storytelling from raw unscripted material. Show us your best work Strong short-form editing instinct. You know what makes someone stop scrolling. Platform-native editing for vertical and horizontal formats DaVinci Resolve proficiency is strongly preferred. Shared project experience is a major plus. Not a dealbreaker, but a significant advantage Multicam editing experience is a bonus, ideally from live events, reality TV, or unscripted formats Competent sound design and colour grading. Your grades should be clean and your audio broadcast-ready Self-directed. You can take a rough brief and deliver a polished first cut without needing frame-by-frame instructions Reliable. You deliver when you say you will. If something changes, you communicate before the deadline, not after Open to AI-assisted workflows. Specifically Higgsfield for short-form content. You don't need to be an expert, but you need to be curious Politically impartial and professional. ONDA works with clients across a range of industries, causes, and viewpoints. This role requires a professional, unbiased approach to all content — the work is the work, regardless of subject matterDetails HOURS: Part-time (roughly 30 hours per week) RATE: Competitive monthly retainer, based on experience and portfolio strength LOCATION: Fully remote. Any timezone. Deadlines are the measure, not hours SOFTWARE: DaVinci Resolve strongly preferred DURATION: Ongoing, with a 4-week paid trial period START: May 2026

title: Customer Retention Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Retention Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us: Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market.We're building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us?About you: This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Retention Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you'll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them. As a result, retained revenue will follow with subscription renewals, of which you will be responsible for attaining a monthly quota.What You'll Own: Responsible for reducing churn by retaining customers and revenue. You'll own a monthly customer retention quota as your main KPI. Apply approved retention strategies (in-app credits, billing credits, plan downgrades, and success enablement) within defined guidelines. Intercept downgrade requests and reposition value through usage planning, campaign scheduling, and ROI alignment before the plan change is approved. Identify and recover failed onboarding cases by re-driving activation and time-to-first-value. Perform proactive outreach to low-usage and disengaged accounts using structured "silent churn" playbooks to re-engage customers before cancellation intent surfaces. Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.What We're Looking For: 5+ years in a customer retention or account management role. 3+ years within a SaaS company. Conduct 50+ weekly retention calls via phone or Google Meet. Proven ability to analyze customer behavior, identify churn risks, and take targeted action to retain accounts. Strong objection handling, negotiation, and behavioral communication skills with the ability to influence customer decisions under pressure. Ability to diagnose and act on different churn drivers (budget, usage, performance, lifecycle, compliance) with tailored retention strategies. Able to work efficiently in a high-activity environment without sacrificing quality. Comfortable holding long-format video calls for reviewing customer accounts and demonstrating product value. Coachable, performance-driven, accountable, and a strong team player. Proficient or native level English (full business fluency). Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 am and 7 pm EST, Monday to Friday. Bonus Points: Experience working at a CPaaS or Martech SaaS company. Experience working with real estate professionals.️ Why Smarter Contact? USD base compensation 15 days PTO + 5 sick days + 10 floating holidays (6 weeks off) High autonomy, fast execution, real impact Professional development benefit Wellness benefit Employment anniversary and birthday gift Quarterly health allowance Remote-first team with a strong performance culture This opportunity is offered as a full-time independent contractor rolePlease Don't Apply If: You prefer a low-pressure, low-output environment You're not fluent in English or are uncomfortable communicating directly with cross-functional teams You don't meet the minimum customer success experience No experience working for a SaaS companyReady to grow with us? We're looking for a proven Customer Retention Specialist ready to build the next chapter of their career — and stay for the long haul. If that's you, we'd love to hear from you.
